result.notes: Meta's official Threads API (graph.threads.net / graph.threads.com), REST-style HTTP endpoints (GET/POST) under the Graph API family, distinct from Meta's older Instagram/Facebook Graph API but structurally identical. Free Meta developer account + app creation gets a developer immediate self-testing access via the "Threads Tester" role, but any permission used against real (non-tester) users requires Meta App Review and app publishing, which is a gated approval process, not pure self-serve. Only 9 documented endpoint groups (Publishing, Media Retrieval, Reply Management, User, Locations, Location Search, Insights, oEmbed, Debug) — small breadth. No official Meta-published MCP server found; only a community project (token-pilot) surfaced in registry hints.
result.one_liner: Threads API is Meta's official REST-style HTTP API (graph.threads.net) letting developers publish posts, manage replies, and pull insights/profile data for the Threads social app.
